title: Comparative transcriptome analysis reveals abscisic acid-induced bHLH transcription factors involved in saikosaponin biosynthesis in Bupleurum chinense DC.
authors: Wang, Han; Hu, Shanqun; Li, Tong; Qu, Xuejie; Zhang, Jiaqi; Wang, Baoshun; Sun, Yixuan; Cao, Rui; Yan, Yutong; Song, Ze; Zhang, Xia'nan; Luo, Rong; Tong, Yuru; Liu, Changli
one_liner_zh: 该文通过转录组分析鉴定ABA诱导的bHLH转录因子并预测其与G-box DNA结合的关键残基，虽涉及TF-DNA结合预测但以表达调控为主、方法深度有限，对TF-DNA互作建模有参考价值。
abstract: Bupleurum chinense DC. a medicinal plant valued for saikosaponins (SSs) with antipyretic and hepatoprotective properties, faces constrained SS biosynthesis mediated by abscisic acid (ABA) during growth. Basic helix-loop-helix (bHLH) transcription factors (TFs) are hypothesized to participate in ABA signaling cascades, but their mechanistic role in SS regulation remains undefined. In this study, 20 differentially expressed BcbHLH genes were identified by transcriptomic profiling of ABA-induced hairy roots, with four MYC-family candidates (BcbHLH1-BcbHLH4) demonstrating ABA-responsive regulatory potential. ABA exposure (100 or 200 mumol/L, 24-72 h) induced dose-dependent SS reduction, while correlation analyses revealed coordinated expression between BcbHLH1-BcHMGR (r = 0.62) and BcbHLH4-BcBAS (r = 0.78), pinpointing these TFs as critical nodes in SS pathway modulation. Tissue-specific profiling showed predominant BcbHLH expression in stems and young leaves, with nuclear localization confirming their transcriptional regulatory organelles. BcbHLH3/4 exhibited transcriptional activation activity in the MYC_N domain, while molecular docking predicted 11th Arginine in the HLH domain as essential for G-box DNA binding. Collectively, our findings suggest that BcbHLH1-BcbHLH4 may serve as potential switches for fine-tuning ABA responsiveness in SS biosynthesis. Strategic manipulation of BcbHLH activity through genetic engineering approaches such as CRISPR-based editing or overexpression could alleviate ABA-mediated biosynthetic repression. Furthermore, precision engineering of the critical functional domain in BcbHLH could enhance promoter-binding activity to target genes and improve SS biosynthesis efficiency. These findings provide a reference framework for harnessing transcriptional regulators to optimize SS production in Bupleurum chinense DC.
abstract_zh: 柴胡（Bupleurum chinense DC.）是一种药用植物，因其含有具有解热和保肝特性的柴胡皂苷（saikosaponins, SSs）而备受重视，但在生长过程中，其SS生物合成受到脱落酸（abscisic acid, ABA）的介导抑制。碱性螺旋-环-螺旋（basic helix-loop-helix, bHLH）转录因子（transcription factors, TFs）被推测参与ABA信号级联反应，但其在SS调控中的机制作用仍不明确。本研究通过ABA诱导毛状根的转录组分析，鉴定出20个差异表达的BcbHLH基因，其中四个MYC家族候选基因（BcbHLH1-BcbHLH4）显示出ABA响应性调控潜力。ABA处理（100或200 μmol/L，24-72小时）诱导SS含量呈剂量依赖性降低，而相关性分析揭示了BcbHLH1-BcHMGR（r = 0.62）和BcbHLH4-BcBAS（r = 0.78）之间的协同表达，表明这些转录因子是SS通路调控中的关键节点。组织特异性分析显示BcbHLH主要在茎和幼叶中表达，核定位证实了其转录调控细胞器的功能。BcbHLH3/4在MYC_N结构域中表现出转录激活活性，而分子对接预测HLH结构域中的第11位精氨酸对G-box DNA结合至关重要。综合来看，我们的研究结果表明，BcbHLH1-BcbHLH4可能作为微调SS生物合成中ABA响应性的潜在开关。通过基因工程手段（如基于CRISPR的编辑或过表达）对BcbHLH活性进行策略性操作，可缓解ABA介导的生物合成抑制。此外，对BcbHLH关键功能结构域的精准工程改造可增强其与靶基因启动子的结合活性，从而提高SS生物合成效率。这些发现为利用转录调控因子优化柴胡中SS产量提供了参考框架。
